title: A Conditional Fourteen-Point Case of Erdős Problem 132
abstract: Formalizes the planar Hopf--Pannwitz diameter bound and proves the fourteen-point low-multiplicity conclusion conditional on exactly two remaining published interfaces: the known maximum-cardinality bound for planar sets with at most six distances and the Szöllősi--Östergård classification of thirteen-point planar six-distance sets. Internally derives the exact failure profile and endpoint deletion, constructs the three classified templates, eliminates the nonregular cases by multiplicity, and excludes the regular tridecagon extension by explicit second and fourth moments. The general Erdős problem remains open.

informal.LeanPool.Erdos132N14.hopfPannwitzLowMult: Every injectively labelled fourteen-point planar configuration has a realized distance represented by at most fourteen unordered pairs; the proof chooses that distance to be a diameter.
informal.LeanPool.Erdos132N14.erdos132_for_fourte: Assuming precisely the published planar few-distance cardinality and Szöllősi--Östergård classification interfaces, every injectively labelled fourteen-point planar configuration realizes at least two distances whose unordered-pair multiplicities are at most fourteen.
